# Configuration reference

<!-- Generated by DocumentationTests. Do not edit manually. -->

This reference is generated from every command-line option registered by the
standard build of NBXplorer. Use the same application version that you deploy
because options and defaults can change between releases.

Configuration-file keys, environment variables, and command-line options feed
the same configuration system. Environment variables use the `NBXPLORER_`
prefix. Run `NBXplorer --help` to inspect the deployed version directly.

## Process and network

| Command line | Configuration file | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `-? \| -h \| --help` | N/A | N/A | Show help information |
| `-n \| --network` | `network` | `NBXPLORER_NETWORK` | Set the network among (mainnet,testnet,regtest,signet) (default: mainnet) |
| `--chains` | `chains` | `NBXPLORER_CHAINS` | Chains to support comma separated (default: btc, available: agm,btc,btx,ltc,doge,pepe,bch,grs,btg,dash,trc,polis,mona,ftc,ufo,via,xmcc,gbx,colx,chc,lbtc,qtum,html,mue) |
| `-c \| --conf` | `conf` | `NBXPLORER_CONF` | The configuration file |
| `-p \| --port` | `port` | `NBXPLORER_PORT` | The port on which to listen |
| `-b \| --bind` | `bind` | `NBXPLORER_BIND` | The address on which to bind |
| `-d \| --datadir` | `datadir` | `NBXPLORER_DATADIR` | The data directory |

## Database

| Command line | Configuration file | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--postgres` | `postgres` | `NBXPLORER_POSTGRES` | Use PostgresSQL backend. Set the connection string of the postgres backend (For example: "User ID=postgres;Host=postgres;Port=5432;Application Name=nbxplorer;Database=nbxplorer", more options on https://www.npgsql.org/doc/connection-string-parameters.html) |

## HTTP and authentication

| Command line | Configuration file | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--noauth` | `noauth` | `NBXPLORER_NOAUTH` | Disable cookie authentication |
| `--instancename` | `instancename` | `NBXPLORER_INSTANCENAME` | Define an instance name for this server that, if not null, will show in status response and in HTTP response headers (default: empty) |
| `--exposerpc` | `exposerpc` | `NBXPLORER_EXPOSERPC` | Expose the node RPC through the REST API (default: false) |

## Wallet tracking and scanning

| Command line | Configuration file | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--nowarmup` | `nowarmup` | `NBXPLORER_NOWARMUP` | If true and on regtest, no block will be generated by NBXplorer when the tip got stalled or if no block has been mined (default: false) |
| `--customkeypathtemplate` | `customkeypathtemplate` | `NBXPLORER_CUSTOMKEYPATHTEMPLATE` | Define an additional derivation path tracked by NBXplorer (Format: m/1/392/*/29, default: empty) |
| `--maxgapsize` | `maxgapsize` | `NBXPLORER_MAXGAPSIZE` | The maximum gap address count on which the explorer will track derivation schemes (default: 30) |
| `--mingapsize` | `mingapsize` | `NBXPLORER_MINGAPSIZE` | The minimum gap address count on which the explorer will track derivation schemes (default: 20) |
| `--trimevents` | `trimevents` | `NBXPLORER_TRIMEVENTS` | When NBXplorer starts, NBXplorer will remove old events to reach this count. No trimming if equals to less than 0 (default: -1) |

## Logging and diagnostics

| Command line | Configuration file | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--signalfilesdir` | `signalfilesdir` | `NBXPLORER_SIGNALFILESDIR` | The directory where files signaling if a chain is ready is created (default: the network specific datadir) |
| `-v \| --verbose` | `verbose` | `NBXPLORER_VERBOSE` | Verbose logs (default: false) |

## Chain-specific node and RPC settings

Replace `<crypto>` with a lowercase code in command-line and configuration-file
settings, and replace `<CRYPTO>` with its uppercase code in environment
variables. For example, Bitcoin's RPC URL is `--btcrpcurl`, `btc.rpc.url`,
or `NBXPLORER_BTCRPCURL`. The `minutxovalue` setting does not apply to
Liquid (`LBTC`).

Supported codes in this build: `AGM`, `BTC`, `BTX`, `LTC`, `DOGE`, `PEPE`, `BCH`, `GRS`, `BTG`, `DASH`, `TRC`, `POLIS`, `MONA`, `FTC`, `UFO`, `VIA`, `XMCC`, `GBX`, `COLX`, `CHC`, `LBTC`, `QTUM`, `HTML`, `MUE`.

| Command line | Configuration file | Environment | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--<crypto>rescan` | `<crypto>.rescan` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RESCAN` | Rescan from startheight |
| `--<crypto>rescaniftimebefore` | `<crypto>.rescaniftimebefore` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RESCANIFTIMEBEFORE` | Only perform rescan if before timestamp (UTC unix timestamp in seconds) (requires --&lt;crypto&gt;rescan) |
| `--<crypto>rpcuser` | `<crypto>.rpc.user` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RPCUSER` | RPC authentication method 1: The RPC user (default: using cookie auth from default network folder) |
| `--<crypto>rpcdefaultwallet` | `<crypto>.rpc.defaultwallet` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RPCDEFAULTWALLET` | The wallet context to use for node RPC requests (default: no wallet context) |
| `--<crypto>rpcpassword` | `<crypto>.rpc.password` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RPCPASSWORD` | RPC authentication method 1: The RPC password (default: using cookie auth from default network folder) |
| `--<crypto>rpccookiefile` | `<crypto>.rpc.cookiefile` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RPCCOOKIEFILE` | RPC authentication method 2: The RPC cookiefile (default: using cookie auth from default network folder) |
| `--<crypto>rpcauth` | `<crypto>.rpc.auth` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RPCAUTH` | RPC authentication method 3: user:password or cookiefile=path (default: using cookie auth from default network folder) |
| `--<crypto>rpcurl` | `<crypto>.rpc.url` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>RPCURL` | The RPC server url (default: default rpc server depended on the network) |
| `--<crypto>startheight` | `<crypto>.startheight` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>STARTHEIGHT` | The height where starting the scan (default: where your rpc server was synched when you first started this program) |
| `--<crypto>minutxovalue` | `<crypto>.minutxovalue` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>MINUTXOVALUE` | The minimum value of tracked UTXOs in satoshis; lower-value UTXOs are ignored (default: -1, disabled) |
| `--<crypto>nodeendpoint` | `<crypto>.node.endpoint` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>NODEENDPOINT` | The p2p connection to a Bitcoin node, make sure you are whitelisted (default: default p2p node on localhost, depends on network) |
| `--<crypto>exposerpc` | `<crypto>.exposerpc` | `NBXPLORER_<CRYPTO>EXPOSERPC` | Expose the node RPCs through the REST API (default: false) |
